layout.arrangement: Landscape slide on a light-gray background with a thin dark-red/maroon rectangular frame inset near the edges. A yellow circle badge with '32' sits at the top-right corner. The body is two red-bordered rectangular panels stacked vertically with a small gap: the top panel is headed 'Initialized weights' and the bottom panel 'Updated weights (after iteration # 1)' (both in red italic at the panel's top-left). Inside each panel the content flows left-to-right: Input column at far left (header 'Input', column vector x=(1,5), two black input dots, 'Bias' + blue '1' circle), hidden layer of three yellow circles (3 top, 4 middle, 5 bottom) at center-left with a second 'Bias' + blue '1' circle below node 5, output layer of two peach circles (6 top, 7 bottom) at center-right, then a bold output column vector, a red double-headed arrow (⇔), and at far right the 'Target' header above a bold target column vector with t₆/t₇ beside it. 'η = 5' in red sits at the bottom-right inside each panel.

layout.hierarchy: The two red italic panel titles are the largest text and anchor each panel. Next in size are the blue underlined italic section labels (Input, Output) and the black underlined italic 'Target'. The network nodes are the dominant shapes: yellow hidden circles and peach output circles are largest, black input dots smaller, light-blue bias circles smallest. Weight values are small green/magenta text along thin gray edges. Output/target vectors are bold black with large parentheses. The yellow '32' badge is a small accent at top-right.

visual_elements.description: TOP PANEL ('Initialized weights'). Architecture: 2 inputs + 1 bias → 3 hidden neurons + 1 bias → 2 output neurons. Far left: blue underlined italic 'Input' header; column vector with rows 'x₁ ( 1 )' and 'x₂ ( 5 )' (x labels blue, values black, large parentheses); to the right of the vector two solid black circles (input neurons), each with a small red dot on its right edge; below them blue italic 'Bias' and a light-blue circle containing '1'. Center-left: three yellow circles stacked vertically, numbered 3 (top), 4 (middle), 5 (bottom) in bold blue, each with a blue label O₃ / O₄ / O₅ at its upper right and a small red dot on its left edge; below node 5 another blue italic 'Bias' label with a light-blue '1' circle. Center-right: two peach circles numbered 6 (top) and 7 (bottom) in bold blue, with blue labels O₆ and O₇ above-right. Far right: blue underlined italic 'Output' header above the output nodes; to their right a bold black column vector ( 0.791 ; 0.791 ); then a red double-headed horizontal arrow (⇔); then black underlined italic 'Target' header above a bold black column vector ( 0 ; 1 ) with blue t₆ beside 0 and t₇ beside 1. Thin gray lines connect every input/bias node to every hidden node, and every hidden/bias node to every output node. GREEN weight labels on input→hidden edges: from x₁: 0.1 (to node 3), 0.2 (to node 4), 0.4 (to node 5); from x₂: 0.3 (to 3), 0.5 (to 4), 0.6 (to 5); from bias: 0.1, 0.1, 0.1. MAGENTA weight labels on hidden→output edges: from node 3: 0.3 (to 6), 0.3 (to 7); from node 4: 0.4, 0.4; from node 5: 0.5, 0.5; from bias: 0.2 (to 6), 0.2 (to 7). Red 'η = 5' at the panel's bottom-right corner.

recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to light gray #F2F2F2 and draw a thin dark-maroon (#8B1A1A) rectangle frame inset ~2% from all edges. 2) Top-right: add a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with purple (#7030A0) outline containing '32'. 3) Draw the top red-bordered (#C00000) rectangle occupying roughly the top 14%-53% of slide height; type 'Initialized weights' in red italic at its top-left inside. 4) Inside the top panel, far left: blue italic underlined 'Input'; draw a column vector with large parentheses containing 1 (row labeled x₁ in blue) and 5 (row labeled x₂ in blue); place two solid black circles to the right of the vector rows, each with a small red dot; below them blue italic 'Bias' and a light-blue (#9DC3E6) circle with '1'. 5) At center-left draw three yellow (#FFFF99) circles stacked vertically, labeled 3, 4, 5 in bold blue, with blue O₃/O₄/O₅ at each upper-right; below node 5 add 'Bias' + light-blue '1' circle. 6) Connect every left node (2 inputs + bias) to every hidden node with thin gray lines; put green (#00A651) labels near the source ends: 0.1/0.2/0.4 from x₁, 0.3/0.5/0.6 from x₂, 0.1/0.1/0.1 from bias. 7) At center-right draw two peach (#F8CBAD) circles labeled 6 and 7 in bold blue with O₆/O₇ labels; connect all hidden nodes + bias to them with gray lines and magenta labels: 0.3/0.3 from node 3, 0.4/0.4 from node 4, 0.5/0.5 from node 5, 0.2/0.2 from bias. 8) Right of the output nodes: blue underlined 'Output' header; bold column vector (0.791 over 0.791); a red double-headed arrow ⇔; black underlined italic 'Target' above bold vector (0 over 1) with t₆, t₇ to its right. 9) Add red 'η = 5' at the panel's bottom-right. 10) Repeat steps 3-9 for the bottom panel (top ~56%-96% height) with title 'Updated weights (after iteration # 1)' and the updated values: green 0.125/0.215/0.527 (x₁), 0.305/0.575/0.625 (x₂), 0.125/0.115/0.105 (bias); magenta -0.29/-0.458 (node 3), -0.218/-0.565 (node 4), -0.134/-0.669 (node 5), -0.445/-0.375 (bias); output vector (0.352 over 0.835); target (0 over 1) with t₆/t₇; 'η = 5' bottom-right.
